items.deliverable:
What Square can already do, free: Square Online's free plan takes pickup and local-delivery orders, lets customers order ahead for a set date and time, and pulls items and prices from the same Square catalog as the register, so updating an item once updates the site. It charges 2.9% + 30c per online sale; customer accounts, a custom domain and product reviews need a paid plan.

What the HQ could add: Square's developer API (free) can read orders and sales with a read-only access token, so the HQ could post a weekly JustBaked sales recap and flag big orders. Zapier also connects to Square (New Order, New Payment, New Customer triggers) to text or email each new order, but it is a separate account with its own limits.

What only you or Alyiza can do, at a computer, about 15 minutes: in the Square Dashboard, turn on pickup scheduling and order-ahead, confirm order alerts go to her phone in the Square app, and, if you want the weekly recap, create a read-only personal access token in Square's Developer Dashboard and give it to the HQ as a secret.

Recommendation: start free. Turn on order-ahead and phone alerts in Square, then decide on the HQ recap after a month of orders.

Sources: squareup.com/us/en/online-store/plans, business.org Square Online review, help.zapier.com Square guide, developer.squareup.com Orders and Reporting docs.
